title: Tasbeehat e Hazrat e Zahra
body:
rooyie lab ha
noor o qadr o kosar o taha
zikr-e noorani-e aashik ha
Tasbihaat-e hazrat-e zahra
allahu akbar een hame jalal
allahu akbar een hame shakooh
allahu akbar dar rahe ali
fatima istade misle ye koh
sal-lallahu alaik ya fatimeh
allah o akbar ummat ka zawaal
allah o akbar zahra sa ka ye haal
allah o akbar sher e zuljalaal
hotey haii gum se ghut ghut ke nidhaal
sallal la
(1)
waa gurbataa!
tanhaii hai aur mola
zair e lab hai lamha lamha
tasbeehaat e hazrat e zahraa sa
alhamdolillah shikwaa na gilaa
alhamdolillah wo sabr kiyaa
alhamdolillah har gam pe sadaa
maulaayee zahraa sa sajdey mein milaa
sallal laa ho
(2)
waa hasrataah!
taarikiyaaii shab mein haider
tanhaiiyooN mein ro ro kar
padhtey haii aayaat e kausar
mushkil kusha kii wo seena sipar
jab kar rahii thii duniyaa se safar
kaisaa samaaN tha dam e gusl o kafan
zakhm e pehluu pe thii maula ki nazar
sallal la
(3)
yaa sayyada !
pahochaaya tu ne ye qalmaa
kehkar ali un wali ullah
ghar ghar ali un wali ulllah
jab tak terii saansooN ka tha dawa
tera wazeefa tha har subh o shaam
hathooN ko apne pehlu pe rakha
ghar ghar deti thiye wilayat ka payaam
(4)
subhaan allah wo zahra kii wafaa
subhaan allah mola pe hai fidaa
subhaan allah
baraey murtaza
darbaar e baatil mein haq kii sadaa
5)
Dard e jigar batla rahi hai khamoshi
Kuch haalaat e hazrat e zahra
Tasbeehat e hazrat e zahra
Khaliq se hungam e raaz o niyaz
Karti nahi hai hath o ko daraaz
Jisdin se todi gayi passliyan
Padhti nahi hai khadey ho key namaz
6)
Waa turbataa!
Aze y baqaiyaa pe jaake
Chalees qabrein bana ke
Zahra sa kii mayyat chupaa ke
Thaamein huye bacchooN kii ungliyaaN
Taktey they mola suyee aasmaaN
Zahra sa ki furqat meiN pesh e khuda
Faryaad kartey they shah e zamaaN
Sallal la ho ——
7)
Ho Lanat e uspar jo baad paighambar
Chord aaya daman e haider
Jalawaya siddiqa ka ghar
Baiyat jo todey uspar lanate
Muh ko jo modey uspar lanate
Aal e nabi hai kashti e nijaat
Unko jo chodey uspar lanate
Salal____
8)
Ya Fatima Raah e Baqqiya ho asaaN
Pochey shafi o RizwaaN
Ho teri chaukat ke mehmaaN
Allah o akbar is dar ki ata
Alhumdulillah razi hai gadah
Subhanallah binte nabi teri
Marzi bani hai marzi e khuda
